concepts.title: Degree and Classification of Polynomials
concepts.definition: The degree of a polynomial is the highest power of the variable in its terms, which categorizes it into linear, quadratic, or cubic types.
concepts.key_idea: The highest exponent of the variable determines the polynomial's classification.
question_patterns: what is the degree of the polynomial
classify the polynomial as linear, quadratic or cubic
identify the degree of the given expression
determine if the polynomial is linear or quadratic
find the degree of the polynomial

solution_steps.action: Identify the exponents of all terms
solution_steps.explain: Look at the power of the variable in each term of the polynomial expression.
The highest power of the variable is defined as the degree of the polynomial.
If the degree is 1, it is a linear polynomial; if 2, it is a quadratic polynomial; if 3, it is a cubic polynomial.

concepts.title: Value of a Polynomial at a Point
concepts.definition: The value of a polynomial p(x) at a given real number k is obtained by substituting k for the variable x throughout the expression.
concepts.formula: p(k) = a * k^2 + b * k + c
concepts.key_idea: Substitute the target real number into the polynomial expression and evaluate the arithmetic result.
question_patterns: find the value of the polynomial at x = k
evaluate the polynomial for a given value of x
calculate p(k) for the polynomial p(x)
what is the value of the expression when x is substituted with

solution_steps.explain: Multiply coefficient a by the square of k
Multiply coefficient b by k

solution_steps.action: Sum the terms and constant to find the value
solution_steps.explain: Add the quadratic term, linear term, and constant term c

concepts.title: Geometrical Meaning of Zeroes
concepts.definition: The real zeroes of a polynomial correspond to the x-coordinates of the points where its graph intersects or touches the x-axis.
concepts.key_idea: The number of real zeroes is equal to the number of intersection points of the graph with the x-axis.
question_patterns: find the number of zeroes of p(x) from the graph
how many zeroes does the polynomial have based on the given graph
determine the number of zeroes from the curve
count the number of zeroes of the polynomial shown in the figure

solution_steps.action: Examine the graph of y = p(x)
solution_steps.explain: Look at the curve plotted on the Cartesian plane.

solution_steps.action: Identify the points of intersection with the x-axis
solution_steps.explain: Locate all points where the graph crosses or touches the horizontal axis.
The total number of these points is equal to the number of real zeroes of the polynomial.

concepts.title: Finding Zeroes of a Quadratic Polynomial
concepts.definition: Finding the values of the variable that make a quadratic polynomial equal to zero, typically by factoring it into linear factors.
concepts.formula: ax^2 + bx + c = a(x - alpha)(x - beta)
concepts.key_idea: Splitting the middle term to factorize and solve for the roots.

solution_steps.explain: Calculate b^2 - 4ac to determine the nature of roots

concepts.title: Relationship between Zeroes and Coefficients of a Quadratic Polynomial
concepts.definition: Verification that the sum of the zeroes of a quadratic polynomial equals -b/a and the product of the zeroes equals c/a.
concepts.key_idea: The coefficients of a quadratic polynomial directly relate to the sum and product of its roots.

solution_steps.action: Compute the product of the zeroes

concepts.title: Formulation of a Quadratic Polynomial
concepts.definition: Constructing a quadratic polynomial when the sum and product of its zeroes are given.
concepts.key_idea: A quadratic polynomial is represented by x^2 - S x + P, where S is the sum and P is the product of the zeroes.
question_patterns: find a quadratic polynomial with the given sum and product of zeroes

solution_steps.explain: The coefficient of x is the negative of the sum of zeroes
The constant term is equal to the product of zeroes

concepts.title: Relationship between Zeroes and Coefficients of a Cubic Polynomial
concepts.definition: The relationships between the three zeroes of a cubic polynomial ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d and its coefficients.
concepts.key_idea: The sum, sum of pairwise products, and product of the roots of a cubic polynomial are determined by its coefficients.
